question: What is the monthly fee for the Everyday Current Account?
expected_answer: The Everyday Current Account costs AED 25 per month. The fee is waived with an average monthly balance of AED 5,000 or more, or a monthly salary of at least AED 8,000.
answer: The monthly maintenance fee for the Everyday Current Account is AED 25. This fee is waived when the average monthly balance is AED 5,000 or more, or when a salary of at least AED 8,000 is credited to the account each month. [1]
contexts:
Ledgerly Bank: Fees and Charges - Account maintenance fees

The Everyday Current Account has a monthly maintenance fee of AED 25. The fee is waived when the average monthly balance is AED 5,000 or more, or when a salary of at least AED 8,000 is credited to the account each month.

The Smart Savings Account has no monthly maintenance fee.

The Premier Account has a monthly fee of AED 150, which is waived when the customer holds combined balances of AED 150,000 or more with Ledgerly Bank.

Ledgerly Bank: Accounts and KYC - Savings interest

The Smart Savings Account pays 3.25% annual interest, calculated on the daily balance and credited monthly. The rate is variable and may change with 30 days' notice.

Ledgerly Bank: Transfers and Limits - Daily transfer limits

The default daily limit for transfers through the mobile app and online banking is AED 50,000 per customer, across all accounts.

Customers can raise the daily limit up to AED 250,000 from the app under Settings > Limits. Any increase requires one-time-password (OTP) confirmation, and the new limit becomes active after a 12-hour cooling-off period.

Transfers to a newly added beneficiary are limited to AED 10,000 during the first 24 hours after the beneficiary is added.

Ledgerly Bank: Fees and Charges - Overdraft and late charges

Unarranged overdraft is charged at AED 50 per occurrence, at most once per calendar day.

A returned cheque due to insufficient funds incurs a fee of AED 200.

Unarranged overdraft is charged at AED 50 per occurrence, at most once per calendar day.

A returned cheque due to insufficient funds incurs a fee of AED 200.

Ledgerly Bank: Fees and Charges - Transfer fees

Transfers between two Ledgerly Bank accounts are free of charge.

Local transfers to other UAE banks cost AED 2 per transfer when made through the mobile app or online banking, and AED 10 when requested at a branch.

International transfers (SWIFT) cost AED 30 per transfer. Correspondent bank charges may be deducted by intermediary banks and are outside Ledgerly Bank's control.

Ledgerly Bank: Fees and Charges - Account maintenance fees

The Everyday Current Account has a monthly maintenance fee of AED 25. The fee is waived when the average monthly balance is AED 5,000 or more, or when a salary of at least AED 8,000 is credited to the account each month.

The Smart Savings Account has no monthly maintenance fee.

The Premier Account has a monthly fee of AED 150, which is waived when the customer holds combined balances of AED 150,000 or more with Ledgerly Bank.

Ledgerly Bank will never ask a customer for their full card number, card PIN, CVV, online banking password or one-time password (OTP) by phone, email, SMS or chat. Anyone asking for these details is a fraudster.

Ledgerly Bank: Accounts and KYC - Opening an account

UAE residents aged 18 or over can open an Everyday Current Account or a Smart Savings Account in the mobile app in about 10 minutes.

Required documents: a valid Emirates ID and a valid passport. Non-residents cannot open an account through the app and must visit a branch.

There is no minimum opening deposit for the Everyday Current Account. The Smart Savings Account requires a minimum opening deposit of AED 1,000.

Ledgerly Bank: Transfers and Limits - Processing times

Transfers between Ledgerly Bank accounts are instant, 24/7.

Local transfers to other UAE banks made before 2:00 PM on a business day are credited the same day. Transfers made after 2:00 PM, or on weekends and public holidays, are processed on the next business day.

International SWIFT transfers usually take 1 to 3 business days, depending on the currency and the intermediary banks.

Ledgerly Bank: Security and Complaints - Account security

Online banking sessions log out automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity.

After 3 incorrect password attempts, online banking access is locked for 30 minutes. The customer can unlock it earlier by resetting the password in the app with Emirates ID verification.

Ledgerly Bank: Transfers and Limits - Daily transfer limits

The default daily limit for transfers through the mobile app and online banking is AED 50,000 per customer, across all accounts.

Customers can raise the daily limit up to AED 250,000 from the app under Settings > Limits. Any increase requires one-time-password (OTP) confirmation, and the new limit becomes active after a 12-hour cooling-off period.

Transfers to a newly added beneficiary are limited to AED 10,000 during the first 24 hours after the beneficiary is added.
